format: NetCDF4 (two whole files per initial condition: atmosphere ~10 MB + ocean ~21 MB)
unverified: SamudrACE input variables are defined by the checkpoint (stepper prognostic_names, models/px/samudrace.py:229-233), not in code; the 2.4 GB checkpoint was not loaded and fme is not installed in this venv. The list is every SamudrACELexicon variable present in the published initial-condition files (38 atmosphere + 80 ocean), an upper bound on the model's prognostic input list; the true list may be a few variables shorter (e.g. without t2m/q2m/u10m/v10m).
notes: Only six CM4 model-year timestamps exist (samudrace.py:36-43); 0151-01-06 is the one the package test uses. np.datetime64 at second precision handles year 151.

cache=True (default) stores downloads in the shared HuggingFace hub cache (HF_HOME, samudrace.py:171-172), NOT under EARTH2STUDIO_CACHE: the harness cache wipe does not make trials cold (cache_bytes reports 0). Point HF_HOME at a wiped directory per trial for a true cold run.
Download size is fixed (~31 MB) regardless of variable count. Small real fetch (t2m, thetao2p5m) passed in 11 s; result 180x360 grid.
20 of the 138 lexicon keys are not in the IC files (forcing and diagnostic fields) and raise KeyError.
